component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.nav = m.top.findNode("nav") m.stack = m.top.findNode("stack") m.overlay = m.top.findNode("overlay") m.container = m.top.findNode("container") m.leaf = m.top.findNode("leaf") m.arm = "" m.container2 = m.top.findNode("container2") m.leaf2 = m.top.findNode("leaf2") m.container2.observeField("focusedChild", "onContainerFocus") m.leaf2.observeField("focusedChild", "onLeafFocus") m.container.observeField("focusedChild", "onContainerFocus") m.leaf.observeField("focusedChild", "onLeafFocus") end sub
sub onContainerFocus() if m.arm = "fwd" and m.container.isInFocusChain() then m.arm = "drop" m.leaf.setFocus(true) end if end sub
sub onLeafFocus() if m.arm = "drop" and m.leaf.isInFocusChain() then m.arm = "" m.overlay.setFocus(true) end if end sub
' S5: stale links left in the scene (a forward whose target asks for another node), then a plain ' setFocus on the container whose stale link still leads to its self-linked child. sub runStaleCase(name, container, leaf) m.stack.removeChildrenIndex(m.stack.getChildCount(), 0) m.container = container m.leaf = leaf print "PROBE|" + name + "|start containerFocusable=" + container.focusable.toStr() m.overlay.setFocus(true) m.arm = "fwd" m.container.setFocus(true) m.arm = "" dumpStale(name, "after-drop") m.nav.setFocus(true) dumpStale(name, "nav") m.container.setFocus(true) dumpStale(name, "container-focused") m.nav.setFocus(true) dumpStale(name, "back-to-nav") end sub
sub dumpStale(name, stage) print "PROBE|" + name + "|" + stage + " nav=" + m.nav.hasFocus().toStr() + " overlay=" + m.overlay.hasFocus().toStr() + " container=" + m.container.hasFocus().toStr() + " containerChain=" + m.container.isInFocusChain().toStr() + " leaf=" + m.leaf.hasFocus().toStr() + " leafChain=" + m.leaf.isInFocusChain().toStr() + " links=" + links() end sub
function runProbe(p) ' S1: the target focuses itself in init(); the view forwards to it when it gains the focus. runCase("S1", "Keyboard", true, true, false) ' S2: as S1, a plain Group target. runCase("S2", "Group", true, true, false) ' S3: the target focuses itself in init(); the view does not forward. runCase("S3", "Group", true, false, false) ' S4: no init() focus; the view forwards (control). runCase("S4", "Group", false, true, false) runStaleCase("S5", m.top.findNode("container"), m.top.findNode("leaf")) ' S6: as S5, a container that is not focusable. runStaleCase("S6", m.container2, m.leaf2) ' S7: as S3, a focusable view. runCase("S7", "Group", true, false, true) return invalid end function
sub runCase(name, kind, initFocus, forward, viewFocusable) m.stack.removeChildrenIndex(m.stack.getChildCount(), 0) m.nav.setFocus(true) print "PROBE|" + name + "|start kind=" + kind + " initFocus=" + initFocus.toStr() + " forward=" + forward.toStr() + " viewFocusable=" + viewFocusable.toStr() view = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ProbeView") view.focusable = viewFocusable view.id = "view" view.forward = forward view.initFocus = initFocus view.kind = kind dump(name, "created", view) m.stack.appendChild(view) dump(name, "appended", view) view.setFocus(true) dump(name, "focused", view) m.nav.setFocus(true) dump(name, "back-to-nav", view) end sub
sub dump(name, stage, view) t = view.target print "PROBE|" + name + "|" + stage + " nav=" + m.nav.hasFocus().toStr() + " view=" + view.hasFocus().toStr() + " viewChain=" + view.isInFocusChain().toStr() + " target=" + t.hasFocus().toStr() + " targetChain=" + t.isInFocusChain().toStr() + " links=" + links() end sub
function links() as string s = "" node = m.top for i = 0 to 10 fc = node.focusedChild if fc = invalid then return s + "/-" if fc.isSameNode(node) then return s + "/self" s = s + "/" + fc.id node = fc end for return s end function
